about_the_game:
Core Gameplay:

  • Rhythm-Driven Combat：

All attacks, defenses, and skill activations must follow the musical beat. Hitting notes with precision grants bonus damage and special effects, while mistiming leaves players vulnerable.

  • Roguelike Build System：

In each run, players collect and combine a variety of shared gear and legendary artifacts to create unique combat builds. Repeating the same items allows for tier upgrades, unlocking stronger effects and synergies.

  • Character Progression & Development：

Successfully completing levels unlocks new characters, items, and exclusive skills—supporting different rhythm styles and combat approaches to deepen replayability.

  • Randomized Maps & Enemy Encounters：

Each run features procedurally generated maps, enemy combinations, and loot drops, ensuring every playthrough is a fresh challenge.

  • Boss Fights & Crisis Escalation：

Each major stage ends with a powerful boss featuring unique rhythmic attack patterns and multi-phase mechanics. Victory requires adaptation, precision, and mastery of the beat.
detailed_description:
"404 Rhythm Unleashed" Demo Release Announcement

Hello everyone!
We are excited to share that the demo version of "404 Rhythm Unleashed" is now available!
This is an indie rhythm-action game, with core gameplay focusing on precise Tik points and flow experience.

Core Features:

  • Precise Tik Points: Rhythm cues are almost perfectly synced with the music, providing a smooth flow experience.

  • Adjustable Input Latency: Players can adjust button timing according to their devices for more accurate rhythm gameplay.

Friendly Notice:

  • This demo mainly showcases the core gameplay; some enemies, boss skills, and animations are not fully polished yet.

  • Some sound effects may be temporarily missing, as the game is primarily developed by a single person. They will be gradually added in upcoming demo updates.
    We hope you can understand!

Upcoming Plans:

  • The demo will continue to be updated, adding missing audio, improving animations and boss skills, and including more content.

  • We will continue to refine the experience based on player feedback.

Thank you for your support and patience! Please enjoy the demo and share your feedback with us.
